title: When a new sheet goes live without review
question: Should a newly processed sheet become active by itself, and if so only for locations with no captures (today), or always, or never without review?
context: Today a PDF sheet goes active automatically when its location has no captured realities, and otherwise waits for someone to activate it (DSGN-REQ-027). Activating a sheet on a location with captures can affect alignment and progress (see DEC-003).
